blocks.text: In talks, interviews and press conferences the fuṣḥā It doesn't sound like in the news: those who talk improvisingly drop almost all the endings, use the expressions of connection of the speech and pronounce some consonants in the way of their country. And often, in the same speech, passes from fuṣḥā to the dialect and returns: the data in fuṣḥā, the example in dialect, the line in dialect, the conclusion again in fuṣḥā. This passage is called code switching ( ⁧التَّنَاوُبُ اللُّغَوِيُّ⁩ ) and is not a mistake or lack of culture: it is an instrument with precise functions. In this unit learn how the fuṣḥā spoken (G)75), to recognize the signals of the passage to the dialect, to understand its function (G76) and to make it into translation. It is also the first unit of the module B2.4, dedicated to oral variation and production. Three weeks, while EGY concludes-18.
